title: Ascend SoC Profile
description: Unified declarative hardware manifest for Ascend NPU tooling. One file per SoC in a shared profiles/ directory describes everything ascend-pipesim (analytical simulation) and ascend_analyzer (static AST auditing) need, so new chips or commercial binnings are added as data, never as source-code changes. Tool-neutral by design: each consumer validates and reads the subset it needs; unknown sections must be ignored, not rejected.

else.comment: Standalone profile: the core sections must be present in full.

then.comment: A commercial/tender label derives from real silicon: it must name a base and may not redefine microarchitecture. Identity, aliases, notes and system binning metadata are the only legal overrides.

schema_version.description: Manifest format revision. Loaders reject unknown major revisions.

soc_name.description: Canonical target name, matching the file name stem and the value passed to --arch / --chip.

display_name.description: Human-readable marketing/series name shown in reports.

isa_generation.description: Microarchitecture generation. Gates instruction-set features and structural invariants.

base_profile.description: Optional parent profile this one derives from. Every absent field is inherited (deep merge: objects merge per-key, arrays and scalars replace). A profile that sets base_profile and only system/commercial metadata is a commercial binning, not a new architecture.

aliases.description: Alternate names accepted by --arch / --chip lookups (normalized: lower-case, '-' and '_' stripped).

commercial_label.description: True when this name is a commercial/tender designation layered over base_profile silicon rather than an independent die. Such profiles MUST NOT introduce microarchitectural facts (pools, channels, dtype throughputs) that differ from their base.

provisional.description: Capacities inferred rather than datasheet-confirmed; consumers surface this in reports.

system.description: Chip- and package-level facts outside the single-AI-Core microarchitecture.

ai_cores.description: AI Cores enabled in this binning (all engines).

hbm_bandwidth_gbps.description: Aggregate off-chip bandwidth. No independent calibration is implied for commercial_label profiles.

decoupled_vector_core.description: False on fused Cube+Vector parts, where a Vector epilogue blocks Cube issue.

access_block_bytes.description: Natural SRAM access granule (the 32 B quantization block shared by bank interleave, stride checks and gap accounting).

memory_domains.description: Physically disjoint storage pools. GM, L1, L0A, L0B, L0C, UB are the DaVinci core set; BT (bias table) and FB (fixpipe parameter buffer) are analyzer-side pools a simulator may ignore.

alignment_bytes.description: Required base-offset alignment of any allocation.

size_alignment_bytes.description: Required alignment of an allocation's total length; defaults to alignment_bytes.

stride_alignment_bytes.description: Required alignment of DMA strides expressed in bytes; defaults to alignment_bytes.

bank_stride_bytes.description: Interleave period per bank; defaults to access_block_bytes.

element_bytes.description: Logical element size for typed pools (L0C accumulator: 4 B fp32/int32). Informational: keeps accumulator sizing next to the capacity it derives from.

base_latency_cycles.description: Affine latency term charged per transfer (simulator-side; the static auditor ignores it).

efficiency.description: Static derate, e.g. for an in-flight ND->NZ reformat.

k0.description: k0 of the FP16/BF16 baseline fractal (16); the per-dtype profile carries the actual widening.

dtype_profiles.description: Per-element-type Cube behaviour. macs_per_cycle is the sustained MAC rate; k0 widens as the element narrows because the MAC array is byte-oriented.

read_bytes_per_cycle.description: Operand-read throughput fallback when a tile shape cannot be recovered statically.

bytes_per_cycle.description: Sustained element-wise throughput out of the UB.

register_bytes.description: One full vector instruction's register footprint (the 256 B repeat).

synchronization.description: Cross-pipeline semaphore fabric. HardEvent routes themselves are ISA-level (SRC_DST pipe pairs), not per-chip data.

reserved_event_ids.description: EVENT_IDn values owned by the runtime; kernels must not allocate them.

sync_handoff_cycles.description: Analytical SetFlag->WaitFlag hand-off penalty between pipelines.

ub_partitioning.description: SIMD/SIMT parts only: strict UB split between tensors and the SIMT DataCache. Absent on parts where the whole UB serves tensors.

features.description: Optional instruction-set features (e.g. 'mx_cube'). An intrinsic whose requires_feature is absent here cannot be issued on this part.
